title: A Day in Australia
content:
Anna is traveling in Australia with her brother, Lucas. They are spending their vacation in Sydney.

It is a sunny morning. They are walking near the famous Sydney Opera House.

— Look, Lucas! People are taking pictures!

— Yes! And the boats are moving on the water.

Anna is looking at her map.

— Where are we going now?

— We are going to the beach. I want to see the ocean!

They are walking along the street when Anna sees a kangaroo on a sign.

— Look! It is an Australian kangaroo!

Lucas is laughing.

— Maybe we are seeing real kangaroos tomorrow!

In the afternoon, they are sitting on the beach.

The sun is shining, the waves are moving, and people are swimming in the ocean.

— This is a beautiful day! — Anna says.

— Yes. I am really enjoying Australia! — Lucas replies.
